SUBJECT: Laminated Wood "I" Beams

PURPOSE:        To interpret the requirements of the Administrative
code section 27-617 and 27-620 pertaining tofirestoping
requirements per RS 10-8 and Inspection of methods of
construction per Table 10-2 for laminated wood "I" beams used in
fire resistance        rated floor/roof-ceiling aassemblies.
TO establish a new administrative procedure for applicant
notification to the Fire Department of proposed use of laminated
wood "I" beams.

         therefore, subject to controlled inspection.
